Name: Nearby Quick Stack for Android
Author: ArashiDll
Description:
Nearby Quick Stack adds a small [b]Q[/b] button to the inventory screen, letting you quickly stack items from your backpack into nearby chests.
Stand near your chests, open your inventory, tap [b]Q[/b], and any matching stackable items in your inventory will be moved into nearby chests that already contain those items.
This is a small Android-focused quality-of-life mod for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15.0[/b] with [b]SMAPI Android[/b].
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Adds a compact [b]Q[/b] button to the inventory page[/*]
[*]Moves matching stackable items from your backpack into nearby chests[/*]
[*]Only stacks into existing chest stacks by default[/*]
[*]Configurable nearby chest search radius[/*]
[*]Configurable button position[/*]
[*]Optional moved-item text notification[/*]
[*]Small press feedback, sound, and item fade animation[/*]
[*]Supports Generic Mod Config Menu[/*]
[*]Built with Android controls and packaging in mind[/*]
[/list][heading]How to Use[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Open your inventory.[/*]
[*]Stand near one or more chests.[/*]
[*]Make sure the chest already has the item type you want to stack.[/*]
[*]Tap the [b]Q[/b] button.[/*]
[*]Matching items in your inventory will be moved into those nearby chest stacks.[/*]
[/list][heading]Configuration[/heading]
With [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b], you can change:
[list]
[*]Chest search radius[/*]
[*]Q button horizontal position[/*]
[*]Q button vertical position[/*]
[*]Moved-item notification on/off[/*]
[/list][heading]Notes[/heading]
This mod is intentionally conservative. By default, it will [b]not[/b] place new item types into empty chest slots. It only adds to stacks that already exist in nearby chests.
If the button does not sit comfortably on your screen, adjust its position through Generic Mod Config Menu.
[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
Built for:
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley Android [b]1.6.15.0[/b][/*]
[*]SMAPI Android[/*]
[/list][heading]Credits[/heading]
Created by [b]ArashiDLL / Ashe[/b], with Codex and Claude Code.
Made as a focused Android QoL mod for players who just want a quick way to clean up their inventory into nearby chests without opening every chest one by one.
